title: Case: Recipient queries delivery status during nationwide depot systems outage
context: A network-wide IT systems outage at Plover Arc Logistics affects tracking and status updates across all depots. The recipient is asking for a status update on a parcel that was in transit before the outage began. The desk knows the outage is real and ongoing, but has no confirmed revised delivery date.
initial_request: Recipient requests status update on delayed parcel during known network outage.

events.body: ALERT: Nationwide systems outage affecting all tracking and depot operations. Started 08:00 UTC. Tracking portal offline. No ETA on restoration. Manual operations only. Coordination desk to hold status queries pending comms from Network ops.
Gdzie jest moja paczka? DL-907 was supposed to be delivered yesterday. I need it today for my business. Can you tell me when it will arrive? Nie mogę czekać.

events.from: Parcel trace team, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-907 last scanned at Manchester depot 21 Nov 16:30. Parcel status before outage: in transit to final delivery centre. Cannot access current location or route status during outage. Systems restoration ETA unknown. No individual investigation warranted given known network event.
Czekam na odpowiedź. It is very urgent. My supplier will not send more stock if I cannot receive this order. Tell me yes or no - will it come today?

acceptable_actions.summary: Acknowledge outage, confirm parcel was in transit before systems went down, decline to promise a specific delivery date, advise of restoration efforts and suggested follow-up timing.

must: Do not promise or guess a delivery date.
Do not open a one-off trace or investigation for DL-907.
must_not: Send the recipient to Parcel trace team for investigation.
Promise delivery today or any specific date.
Suggest this is an unusual delay requiring escalation.
Forward to Delivery investigations as a lost-parcel case.
expected.reference_message: Thank you for your message. DL-907 was in transit to our delivery centre when a nationwide IT systems outage began this morning at 08:00 UTC. We cannot access tracking or route status until systems are restored. Your parcel has not been lost or delayed unusually - it is affected by the same outage as many others. We will update you as soon as tracking restores and a new delivery date is confirmed. We appreciate your patience during this incident.

rationale: The right move is to contact the recipient with honest status: her parcel was in normal transit before a known network-wide event, and the desk cannot give a delivery date until systems restore. This avoids both the tempting wrong moves of promising a date and opening a one-off investigation that the trace team has already ruled out. No investigation is warranted when the delay is explained by a known operational event affecting hundreds of parcels.
